newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - July 29.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - July 29.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Tuesday:
* Philippine shares are likely to trudge higher after a three-percentage point reduction in domestic interest rates and a relatively stable peso, brokers said.
* Robert Cano, investment analyst of BPI Capital Corp, said the scenario should give investors the confidence to start accumulating bargain stocks.
However, Cano called for caution as the peso remained under pressure from fresh speculative attack.
